description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM model definitions and migration functions related to catalog, schema, and permission management within the Superset project. It includes classes for tables like SqlaTable, Query, SavedQuery, TabState, TableSchema, and Slice, as well as functions for updating, upgrading, and downgrading catalog and schema permissions, and handling related database migrations.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing a table with catalog and schema permissions.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: ORM model for saved queries with catalog information.

classes.name: SavedQuery
classes.description: ORM model for saved queries with catalog info.

classes.name: TabState
classes.description: ORM model for tab state with catalog info.

classes.name: TableSchema
classes.description: ORM model for table schemas with catalog info.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: ORM model for slices/dashboards referencing tables.

methods.name: get_known_schemas
methods.description: Reads all known schemas from existing schema permissions for a database.

methods.name: get_batch_size
methods.description: Determines batch size based on database dialect.

methods.name: update_catalog_column
methods.description: Updates the 'catalog' column in models to a specified catalog or None.

methods.name: update_schema_catalog_perms
methods.description: Updates schema and catalog permissions for tables and charts.

methods.name: delete_models_non_default_catalog
methods.description: Deletes models not in the default catalog.

methods.name: upgrade_catalog_perms
methods.description: Handles upgrade of models and permissions when catalogs are supported.

methods.name: upgrade_database_catalogs
methods.description: Upgrades a database to support a default catalog, updating permissions and models.

methods.name: add_non_default_catalogs
methods.description: Adds permissions for additional catalogs and schemas.

methods.name: upgrade_schema_perms
methods.description: Renames existing schema permissions to include the catalog.

methods.name: create_schema_perms
methods.description: Creates schema permissions for a given catalog.

methods.name: downgrade_catalog_perms
methods.description: Reverses catalog permission upgrades, removing permissions and models.

methods.name: downgrade_database_catalogs
methods.description: Downgrades a database to remove catalog support, deleting models and permissions.

methods.name: downgrade_schema_perms
methods.description: Renames schema permissions to omit the catalog and deletes others.
